sections.title: General Rules Applicable to All Accounts

items.label: Multiple Accounts, Allocation, Hedging, and Coordination
items.detail: Traders may hold more than one Finotive account, provided the maximum allocation limit is not exceeded. Copying trades across the trader's own accounts is permitted. Prohibited: (a) Bypassing allocation limits using multiple profiles, false details, or third parties; (b) Coordinating or mirroring trades with other users; (c) Opening or maintaining hedged, offsetting, or materially correlated multi-account structures designed to manipulate drawdown, equity, or performance metrics. Consequence: Referred to Risk and Compliance team for review.

items.label: News Straddling
items.detail: Trading during high-impact news events is permitted only where the strategy reflects a genuine market view. Traders must not place straddled positions on the same or correlated instruments within 15 minutes before or after a Red or Amber event on the Forex Factory Calendar, earnings calendar, or geopolitical news events. Detected cases referred to Risk and Compliance team.

items.label: Third-Party Tools, Signal Services, Trade Copiers, and Expert Advisors
items.detail: Trade copier tools may be used only to copy the trader's own trades. Prohibited: (a) Copying trades from third-party accounts; (b) Using signal providers, account managers, or challenge-passing services; (c) Allowing another person/group/service to control trading activity; (d) Using EAs not genuinely owned and controlled by the trader. Failure to cooperate may result in account closure and payout rejection.

items.label: Latency Arbitrage and Execution Abuse
items.detail: Trading activity that exploits delayed prices, stale quotes, out-of-sync prices, feed discrepancies, order-processing delays, or infrastructure inefficiencies is prohibited. Review triggers: 30%+ of trades affected by negative slippage, OR 30%+ of total realised profit (or at least 0.5% of Initial Account Balance) earned during quote absence or delayed-price conditions.

items.label: Swap-Free Account Misuse
items.detail: Applies only where the trader has purchased or uses a swap-free account. Swap-free accounts must be used for genuine directional trading. A breach may be identified where trades are opened before daily rollover and closed after rollover, and 50%+ of realised profit in the review period or payout cycle is generated from such rollover-crossing trades.

items.label: IP, Device, Login, and Location Monitoring
items.detail: Finotive may monitor IP addresses, devices, login timestamps, and location data. Use of VPNs, proxies, remote desktops, or similar tools that obscure the trader's true location is not allowed. Failure to complete Enhanced KYC within 72 hours may result in account closure and payout rejection.

items.label: Inactivity
items.detail: Inactivity means 30 consecutive calendar days without executing a trade on the relevant account. Consequence: The account will be permanently closed following notification. Any linked payout request will also be rejected.

items.label: 5 Cumulative Strikes
items.detail: Strikes are issued for confirmed soft breaches. Five cumulative Strikes on any account type result in permanent account closure.

items.label: Immediate Strike
items.detail: Once the breach is confirmed, the Strike is recorded immediately. Examples: Notional Volume breach, Weekend Holding breach on Instant Funding accounts.

items.label: Warning-Based Strike
items.detail: A Strike is recorded only after a further confirmed breach. Examples: Floating Drawdown, Realised-loss recovery.

items.label: Conditional Strike
items.detail: The trader may continue trading to reverse it before requesting payout. A Strike is only applied if the trader submits a payout request while the condition remains unresolved. Examples: Scalping, Excessive One-Sided Position Concentration, Liquidity Abuse, Disproportionate Single-Trade Profit Dependency.

rows: 1st breach = Formal Warning; 2nd breach onward = 1 Strike + payout reduced to 10%
If not reversed before payout request: 1 Strike + payout reduced to 10%
If not reversed before payout request: 1 Strike + payout reduced to 10%

items.label: Strike History Reset
items.detail: Strike history is cleared when a Challenge or Pro account reaches Funded Status, provided five Strikes have not already been accumulated.

items.label: Appeals
items.detail: Appeals must be submitted within 48 hours of enforcement and are accepted only where there is a clear data or pricing error.

items.label: Full Withdrawal Rule
items.detail: If a Strike has been issued in a payout cycle, the trader must withdraw the full available amount for that cycle. Partial withdrawal is not permitted.

items.label: Daily Drawdown Breach
items.detail: Daily Drawdown limit violated. Results in immediate account termination. No warning, no strike, no recovery.

items.label: Maximum Drawdown Breach
items.detail: Maximum Drawdown limit violated. Results in immediate account termination. No warning, no strike, no recovery.

items.label: Five Cumulative Strikes
items.detail: Accumulation of five soft-breach Strikes on any account type results in permanent account closure.

items.label: Hard Breach Consequence
items.detail: Hard Breaches result in immediate or permanent account closure, depending on the breach. No warning and no graduated consequence applies.

items.label: Note
items.value: Hitting any of the limits below closes all open trades and places the account on manual review
items.detail: The following rules trigger automatic trade closure and account manual review when breached.

rows: News straddling around Red or Amber events — Trades opened inside a Red/Amber news window with straddle orders detected (order IDs logged); the account is placed under review.
IP / device / login / location anomalies requiring enhanced KYC — Linked accounts and sessions sharing the same IP, device or location.
Bypass allocation using multiple profiles, false details, or third parties — Reviewed manually by the compliance team.
Unauthorised third-party tools, signal services, copy services, or pass services — Reviewed manually by the compliance team.
Latency arbitrage or execution abuse — Reviewed manually by the compliance team.
Coordinated / mirrored trading across different users — Account-similarity % and matched-account count compared across users.
Swap-free misuse (swap-free accounts only) — Swap-free advantage profit as a share of total realised profit.
Self-developed or self-owned EA without required approval / cooperation — EA approval status, EA-detected flag and EA trade-contribution %; compliance cooperation required if flagged.
Hedging / offsetting / materially correlated multi-account structures — Accounts under one user UUID holding opposite-direction positions, with instrument-level buy/sell exposure and hedge ratio.

items.label: Profitable Day
items.detail: A profitable day is a trading day where the account balance at 17:00:00 New York Time exceeds the previous trading day's closing balance by at least 0.5% of the Initial Account Balance. This definition applies across all account types and phases.

items.label: Trading Day
items.detail: The trading day runs from 17:00:00 New York Time to 16:59:59 New York Time the following day. This applies to all daily drawdown calculations, sequence resets for realised-loss recovery trading, and profitable day assessments across all account types.

items.label: Low-Liquidity Window — Global Instruments
items.detail: Low-liquidity window for global instruments. Used for Liquidity Abuse assessment.

items.label: Low-Liquidity Window — Asian Instruments
items.detail: Low-liquidity window for Asian instruments (Hang Seng Index, Nikkei). Used for Liquidity Abuse assessment.

items.label: Acknowledgement
items.detail: By continuing, the trader confirms that they have read and understood the updated Finotive Trading Rules and the rules applicable to their account type and account phase.

items.label: Possible Consequences
items.value: Range from soft warning to permanent restriction
items.detail: Rule breaches may result in soft warnings, formal warnings, Strikes, payout reduction to 10%, account reset, account downgrade, payout rejection, account closure, or permanent restriction from Finotive, depending on the account type, account phase, rule category, and severity.

items.label: Source of Truth
items.detail: This page summarises the key rules from Section 7 of the Terms & Conditions. If there is any inconsistency between this page, the FAQ, dashboard notification, or any other document, Section 7 of the Terms & Conditions will prevail.
